items.title: Regarding Dylan Harper's slip late in Tuesday's game, Julian Champagnie just told us "finding out it wasn't as serious as it could have been was good news."
items.author: Tom Orsborn
items.body_excerpt:
Regarding Dylan Harper's slip late in Tuesday's game, Julian Champagnie just told us "finding out it wasn't as serious as it could have been was good news."

Also, Harper is here at shootaround walking without a limp.

Spurs ruled him out for tonight due to left hip soreness.
